name: RADIANS
description: RADIANS converts an angle measured in degrees to radians.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The angle in degrees that you want to convert to radians.

howItWorks: RADIANS multiplies the degree value by π/180 to produce the equivalent radian measure. It is the inverse of DEGREES.

howToSteps.name: Select the cell
howToSteps.text: Click the cell for the radian result.

limitations: It only converts degrees to radians, not the reverse (use DEGREES for that).

commonErrors.fix: Supply a numeric angle in degrees.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: RADIANS works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Why convert to radians at all?
faq.answer: Excel's trigonometric functions (SIN, COS, TAN) expect angles in radians.

faq.question: How do I go back to degrees?
